CLIENTSmash Guys
OUR ROLEProduction & Social Media
SERVICESocial Media & Content

THE PROJECT

Smash Guys

The challenge

Smash Guys needed a social presence while its first location was still taking shape. Without a finished storefront, the content had to introduce the food, the people and the personality behind the brand.

Our approach

We used early pop-ups and content shoots to capture product photography, behind-the-scenes moments and short-form stories. A consistent visual direction connected that material across social posts and launch communication.

The work

The engagement brought together ongoing production, social creative and community-focused content. The resulting portfolio shows how the brand could communicate before and after its physical launch.
